title: Compat Recipe Master
description: My custom alternative compat recipe bundles. Icon is inspired from Satisfactory.
body:
# What is this?
This is a mod that integrates most of the fragmented alternative recipe data packs found on the internet into a single mod. It's inspired by the hard drive/MEM alternative recipe features from the Satisfactory.

It's will be **provides** feature is:
- Alternative recipes for existing Minecraft vanilla recipes. (Like compass, clock, etc.)
- Add custom recipes for existing Minecraft vanilla items. (Like saddle, horse armor, etc.)
- Add custom alternative recipes for many compatible mods. (Like Mekanism biomass recipes for many modded foods, etc.)
- Add custom middle-process items for custom alternative items. (In-progress for next version. It will be provided soon.)

And will **NOT** be provides feature is:
- Any Satisfactory-like models like this mod's icon. (It's just a icon.)

# More details
Check my wiki sites: [https://apuc-sw.github.io/global/wiki/en/index_main.html?doc=doc_mcmod_crm&lang=en](https://apuc-sw.github.io/global/wiki/en/index_main.html?doc=doc_mcmod_crm&lang=en)

# Disclaimer
**If you feel that the name is similar to a mod created by someone else, this is purely coincidental and not an intentional use of the same name. The current name of the mod is temporary and may be changed in the future if a suitable idea comes along.**
